name: pricing
title: Pricing page
description: A public pricing view and a pricing-table component: plans from one list, a Monthly/Yearly switch (aria-pressed, yearly discount), a highlighted plan, a feature list per plan and a choose button that emits the plan and billing period (the view sends the visitor to sign-up with them).
notes: Prices are per month; yearly shows the discounted monthly price billed yearly. Link /pricing from the nav.
